reads.what_it_sells: A beginner, instructor-led weekend pottery workshop where I would hand-build clay pieces that ClayRoom fires for later collection.
reads.relevance_feedback: The profile establishes that I am a local adult interested in trying a creative weekend activity, and the email conditionally presents exactly that kind of activity. The email additionally assumes that hand building, rather than wheel pottery, might appeal to me; that preference is unknown. My availability, budget, travel distance and willingness to return for collection are also unknown.
assumed_experiences: Profile-supported: I am interested in trying a creative weekend activity.
Email-only: I may want to try hand-building pottery specifically.
Email-only: I can attend a workshop and return later to collect the fired pieces.
Email-only: an instructor-led beginner introduction suits my level and preferences.
reads.problem_now: There is no urgent problem to solve. This is a discretionary weekend activity that fits an established interest, but the email gives no reason it needs consideration this Tuesday.
reads.biggest_doubt: I cannot quickly judge whether the workshop fits my weekend or budget because the email gives no date, duration or price.
reads.to_click_it_would_have_to: I would have clicked if this email had told me the next workshop date, session length and price.
fixes: Rewrite "Spend a weekend trying hand building" as "Try hand-building pottery in a beginner weekend workshop" so the activity is immediately explicit.

Rewrite "If that sounds like a creative way to spend part of your weekend, inspect the programme to see what the workshop covers." to include the next available date, session length and price, then say "View the programme for the full schedule and details."
Rewrite "View the workshop programme →" as a more informative CTA such as "See dates, price and workshop programme →" if those details are available on the linked page.
